EMD: The Bidder has to submit EMD i.e. 3% of the total cost in the form of demand draft in favour of 04 Guj NU NCC, Porbandar payable at Porbandar. B idder to upload scanned copy of Demand Draft along with bid and also to ensur e that the delivery of hardcopy to the buyer within 5 days of bid end date. Any k ind of EMD exemption is not allowed. 7. Head Office of the service provider must be located in the state of consi gnee. 8. Turnover requirement for Biding Agency: The bidder agency must have a minimum turnover of ₹ 10 lakh in last two financial year. . 2.
